messages:
Maya Chen: quick proposal: add a two-layer fast-gate before kicking off full onboarding bench to cut cost. layer A = micro-ABI checks (tokenizer + kv shapes), layer B = behavioral probes (deterministic golden + short stochastic stability). if either flags, schedule full bench.
Samir Patel: sounds useful. can you sketch what ABI checks include?
Maya Chen: ABI micro-checklist: tokenization parity (token counts for canonical inputs), special-token mapping sanity, output-shape (logits dims), and a 2-step kv-run to validate past_key/past_value shapes. each check is run with tiny inputs and must complete <3s.
Elena Gomez: for behavioral probes, what metrics do we use? sampling noise can be annoying.
Maya Chen: propose two probes: golden-greedy (5 golden prompts, deterministic decode) and stability-sweep (50 short prompts with 3 seeds). metrics: per-step top-k overlap (avg) and per-token KL between logits for greedy path. trigger bench when overlap <0.72 or mean KL >0.06 or instability rate >12%.
Ravi Kumar: add a crash/safety quick check: run the model on a small corpus of malformed inputs to catch OOMs/segfaults. any runtime exception -> immediate manual review.
Samir Patel: rollout plan? feature flag per workspace maybe. also prefer opt-in for a week while we gather stats.
Maya Chen: agree. default opt-in for new submissions, but allow override: force-full-bench and skip-fast-gate flags in registry.
Elena Gomez: we should persist a lightweight fingerprint for golden probe in the model registry to detect drift across versions: store per-prompt top5 token hashes. field name suggestion: onboard_probe_hashes.
Ravi Kumar: one more: some exporters change kv ordering (nh, seq, head, dim) vs (nh, head, seq, dim). the 2-step kv-check must validate both shape and dense/contiguity properties and fail early if mismatch.
Maya Chen: good call. implementation notes: place fast-gate in the ingest lambda with 5s budget; if any gate triggers, emit a structured event to telemetry and enqueue full bench. full bench remains unchanged and runs async on bench-cluster.
Samir Patel: we must measure false positive/negative rates before enforcement. @benchbot retrospective --since=2022-06 --models=prod_approved
benchbot: job queued (id 8831). will post summary in ~30m.
Elena Gomez: monitoring surface: fast_gate_trigger_rate, kv_failure_rate, probe_instability_histogram, bench_followup_latency. visualize KL and overlap distributions so we can tweak.
benchbot: retrospective done. summary: looked at 120 models. fast-gate would have avoided full bench on 68 models. it would have missed 1 subtle regression (seed-linked decoding nondet) and flagged 4 models that later passed full bench (false positives). attaching short report.
Ravi Kumar: 1 miss is OK if we can fix deterministic seed in probes. for the 4 false positives, can we relax thresholds or add a secondary check?
Maya Chen: propose for borderline probes (KL between 0.05-0.07 or overlap 0.7-0.75) we run an expanded probe (more prompts/seeds) before enqueuing full bench. that should cut false positives.
Samir Patel: agree. iterate thresholds after 2 weeks of opt-in data. also add a per-model "record-only" mode so teams can opt to collect probe metrics without gating.
Elena Gomez: docs: include a debugging playbook: how to reproduce kv-fail locally, how to regenerate probe fingerprints, how to request manual vet.
Maya Chen: i'll write the RFC with flow diagram, threshold table (initial), rollout plan (opt-in -> monitor -> flip), and dashboard mockups. pinging @samir @elena @ravi for comments on the draft. :thumbsup:
